title: SMAUG Builder Commands (staff)
body:
Syntax: mcreate <vnum> <name>  |  ocreate <vnum> <name>  |  rcreate <vnum> <name>
        mcopy <source vnum> <new vnum>  |  ocopy <source vnum> <new vnum>
        minvoke <mob vnum>  |  oinvoke <object vnum>
        mfind/ofind/rfind <keyword>
        mlist/olist/rlist [all] [first vnum] [last vnum]

Description: Familiar SMAUG-style shortcuts for creating, copying, finding, listing, and invoking prototypes. 'mcopy'/'ocopy' duplicate every prototype field into a free VNUM, including flags, stats, programs, and shop stock, without spawning an instance or sharing mutable lists with the source. The create commands use the same validated prototypes as mset/oset/rset. Invoke places a mob or object in your current room. Find searches names and keywords and always displays matching vnums. MLIST, OLIST and RLIST default to the area you are standing in. MLIST includes mobs placed there or currently present, OLIST includes placed items and local shop stock, and RLIST shows rooms. Add ALL to any list command to display every prototype or room worldwide (for example, MLIST ALL or OLIST ALL 9000 9999). Optional vnum ranges filter the chosen scope.

Use mstat, ostat, or rstat to inspect the result. Changes become reboot-safe when an Implementor runs 'save world'. Mob experience is calculated automatically from level and cannot be set on a prototype.

&D(Staff only.)&x

Date: 2026-09-22
